assetLiveness.cannotVerify: Its findings stay open and their SLA keeps running: they cannot be verified while the asset does not answer.
assetLiveness.filter.label: Liveness
assetLiveness.goneFindings: Open findings close as obsolete asset (not fixed) where the organization turned it on, and reopen by themselves if the asset is seen again.
assetLiveness.reason.dangling: The name points to a target with no address: a takeover risk. It stays tracked and is never marked gone.
assetLiveness.reason.no_answer: The last checks got no answer (timed out or refused), although the name resolves.
assetLiveness.reason.nxdomain_confirmed: The name has had no address long enough, seen by enough sensors.
assetLiveness.reason.resolver_failed: The DNS lookup failed (SERVFAIL). It may be the sensor's own DNS.
